balls.text: four to end the innings! Full delivery way outside off stump. Rawat walks across his stumps further, generates enough power and smashes it past a very straight deep mid wicket!
six more! Slot ball again and that is poor by Asif. Rawat goes deep into his crease, opens up his stance and pounds it over cow corner!
clears the fence! In the slot outside off stump. Rawat comes down the track, swings it with all his might and smears it over wide long on!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rawat shuffles across and tries to tonk it into tomorrow. Only connects with fresh air, though
length delivery angled across outside off stump. Bracewell drags it towards deep mid wicket for just another single
full delivery outside off stump. Rawat has a swipe at it and squirts it down to short fine leg for a single
full delivery hid way outside off stump. Bracewell takes a step across his stumps and hoicks it to long on's left, collecting a brace in the process
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rawat goes deep into his crease and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket
full toss on middle and leg stump. Rawat uses the reverse sweep and gets it over the fielder at short third man to collect another boundary!
safe! Length delivery outside off stump that stops in the surface. Bracewell has a swing at it and toe-ends it on the bounce to long on
full and way outside off stump. Rawat does well to reach it but can only drag it towards the sweeper at deep mid wicket
full delivery outside off stump. Bracewell plants his front foot and powers it down the ground for just a single
short and wide outside off stump. Rawat goes deep into his crease and cuts it past backward point for a brace
Rawat gets off the mark with a boundary! Full and down the leg side. Rawat gets inside the line early and helps it past short fine leg
full delivery just outside off stump. Rawat comes half forward and defends it towards backward point

cleans him up, brilliant by Sandeep! Another top yorker on middle and leg stump. Maxwell tries to be funky and tries to reverse-sweep it away but the ball is just too good. It sneaks underneath his bat and he hears the death rattle soon after. Take nothing away from this knock, though - it has kept RCB afloat in this contest!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bracewell has a swish at it and chalks it towards long off for one
very full delivery on off stump. Maxwell advances and drives it towards long off for just a single
length delivery outside off stump. Maxwell opts to stay back and cuts it towards deep cover point for one
what a shot! Length delivery hung outside off stump. Maxwell shuffles way across his stumps, gets under it and shovels it over the deep backward square leg fence! Reaches fifty too!
flighted on a length outside off stump. Maxwell lets it go. Not called a wide, and rightly so!
shot! Full delivery way outside off stump. Maxwell reaches out for it, brings his wrists into play and razes it past long on for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Bracewell goes back and punches it towards long off for one
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Bracewell drives it straight back to the bowler
full delivery on leg stump. Bracewell presses forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
full delivery on middle and off stump. Maxwell comes forward and pushes it towards deep cover point for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Bracewell goes back and stabs it into the on side for one

huge appeal, not given! Length delivery on middle and leg stump that pitches and skids through. Karthik is caught on the crease and plays all over it as the ball pins him on the front pad. The umpire says no but RR want to have another look! No bat involved, and Ball Tracking shows that the ball would have thundered into leg stump! RR go bang-bang, and RCB suddenly in a spot of bother now!
full delivery outside off stump. Karthik lunges forward and prods at it, chunking it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket

he tries, but perishes! Length delivery hung outside off stump. This might have been a googly but Lomror tries to hack it away anyway. Slices it badly and Jurel, running in from deep mid wicket, completes the catch after a bit of a juggle!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Lomror taps it into the off side and scurries across to the other end

Asif takes out another big fish! Off-pace delivery on a full length just outside off stump. du Plessis tries to force it past extra cover but does not quite get the timing he is after. He neither gets it past Jaiswal, nor gets it over him. Offers a simple catch off the toe-end, and this is a massive, massive moment in the game!

slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. du Plessis backs away and cloths it just past the bowler. He has, in fact, mistimed it so badly that he gets back for the second as the ball trickles towards long off
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. du Plessis throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it over backward point for a couple of runs
right out of the screws! Dug into the track on off stump. du Plessis picks the length in a flash and dumps it well over the deep mid wicket fence! Fifty for du Plessis too - his seventh this season!
slower delivery that goes awry and slides down the leg side. Maxwell swings and misses. Samson can't gather either as RCB get two extras
length delivery outside off stump that skids through. Maxwell has a waft at it and is beaten for pace. 148.7 kph that!
full and darted into the pads. Maxwell helps it round the corner towards short fine leg for a single
low full toss outside off stump. Maxwell drills it into the stumps at the other end. Was destined for the fence otherwise
right in the slot on middle and leg stump, and it seems like Maxwell is waiting for it. Clean swing through the line and launches it over the bowler's head!
length delivery just outside leg stump. Maxwell tries the reverse-hit again but this time, only jams it off the inside half of the bat into his pads
full and fired into the pads outside leg stump. du Plessis takes a step down the track and eases it behind square on the leg side
full delivery on leg stump. Maxwell comes forward and pushes it down the ground for one
low full toss angled into the stumps. Maxwell works it behind square on the leg side for one more run
four more! Short, wide and that is always dangerous to Maxwell. Jumps up onto his toes, opens his bat face and glides it over backward point
what a shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Maxwell walks down the track and reverse-swats it over short third man for four!
another brilliant yorker at the stumps. du Plessis chalks it back to the bowler, who misfields and ends up conceding a run
excellent yorker on leg stump. Maxwell digs it out past the bowler and has to settle for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis stands tall and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis goes back and knocks it down the ground for one more run
length delivery outside off stump. Maxwell backs away and powers it down the ground towards long off
full delivery that follows the batter way outside leg stump. du Plessis can only tuck it away for a single
very full delivery darted into the batter's toes. du Plessis digs it out towards the bowler
full delivery on leg stump. Maxwell unfurls the reverse and collects a single to deep cover point
carrom ball on a length on leg stump. du Plessis is squared up and squirts the ball into the off side for a single
full delivery outside off stump. Maxwell has a waft at it without much footwork and shanks it towards mid off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Maxwell gets up on his toes and cuts it towards backward point
full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis jabs it towards deep cover point and ambles across to the other end
short and outside off stump again. du Plessis toe-ends it towards the bowler because he is too early into the stroke
short and wide outside off stump. Maxwell runs it down to third man for another single
off-pace delivery on a length on middle and off stump. du Plessis lets the ball come to him before working it into the leg side
full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past extra cover for one more run
low full toss on off stump. Maxwell crouches down low and drags it towards long on for a single
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Maxwell defends it back to the bowler
full delivery on off stump. Maxwell presses forward and pushes it towards extra cover
shot! Marginally short on middle and leg stump. Maxwell picks the length early, rocks back and hammers it past deep mid wicket
full delivery on off stump. du Plessis plants his front foot and drills it down the ground for a single
short and wide outside off stump. Maxwell has all the time in the world to rock back and bisect the gap between deep backward point and deep cover
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Maxwell lets it go as the umpire calls it a wide
full delivery way outside off stump. Maxwell fetches it and sweeps it on the bounce to deep mid wicket. Gets a brace for his troubles
length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis hangs back and jabs it towards deep cover point for one
full delivery outside off stump. Maxwell brings out the reverse again and this time, scuffs it towards backward point for a single
oh! Length delivery outside off stump. Maxwell tries the reverse but seems to miss it altogether
back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis goes back and taps it towards extra cover for a single
Maxwell goes big! Given a bit of air, and this one lands right in the slot on middle and leg. Maxwell backs away and slugs it well over the wide long on fence!
full delivery on middle and off stump. du Plessis presses forward and helps it behind square on the leg side
full delivery way outside leg stump. Maxwell eases it towards deep mid wicket for a single
full delivery darted into the pads. du Plessis flicks it down the ground for one more run
full delivery on leg stump. Maxwell comes forward and pushes it down the ground to get off the mark
carrom ball on a full length on leg stump. du Plessis jams it into the leg side for a single

Asif takes out Kohli! Slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Kohli is completely flummoxed by it and after advancing, tries to reach out in front of his body. The ball spoons up in the air. Jaiswal calls early from extra cover and completes the catch! Asif is delighted, and Kohli departs for a 19-ball 18!
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. du Plessis comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover for another sharp single

oh dear! Full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis drives it towards extra cover and sets off for the single. Kohli, though, sends him back and Jaiswal can't hit the stumps at the batter's end. Samson can't get to the stumps either. Major let-off for RCB!
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. du Plessis drops it into the leg side and scampers back for a couple of runs
shot! Short and wide outside off stump. du Plessis holds his stroke long enough and flays it past backward point for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep cover point
edged and four! Given a bit of air on a length just outside off stump. du Plessis throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that bobbles past short third man
back of a length delivery outside off stump that keeps a little low. du Plessis pokes it into the off side
carrom ball fired in on a length just outside leg stump. du Plessis does not pick it and is beaten on the outside edge
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Kohli gets onto the back foot and chips it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery fired way outside off stump. Kohli leaves it alone as the umpire indulges in some exercise
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis goes deep into his crease and punches it towards mid off for one
short delivery on middle and leg stump. Kohli gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli scuffs it into the off side and hares across to the other end
back of a length delivery on off stump. du Plessis gets onto the back foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli knocks it down the ground for one more run
length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis gets forward and pushes it towards cover for another single
length delivery on leg stump. Kohli goes deep into his crease and stabs it towards mid wicket for a single
length delivery outside off stump. Kohli gets a good stride forward and punches it straight to the fielder at extra cover
very full delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis picks the length a little late and misses. Lucky that did not clip the outside of off stump!
into the stands! Dragged down, and that is just what du Plessis is after! Hangs back in his crease and pummels it over deep mid wicket!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis clears his front leg but ends up shanking his stroke to mid on
full delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli lunges forward and knocks it down the ground for one
full delivery on leg stump. du Plessis drives it down the ground towards mid on and has to settle for just a single
length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis waits deep in his crease and threads it past point for four!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis tucks it away towards deep square leg for just another single
full delivery fired down the leg side. Left alone by the batter and called a wide by the umpire
length delivery that follows the batter way outside leg stump. Kohli works it into the leg side and is intent on the second but his partner is not interested at all
slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Kohli comes half forward and pats it gently towards short mid wicket
length delivery angled into leg stump. du Plessis uses the angle and helps it towards deep square leg for one
length delivery just outside off stump. Kohli advances and tips the ball into the off side before calling du Plessis through for a quick single. Much better communication this time!
length delivery on middle and leg stump that holds in the surface. Kohli closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards mid off
length delivery on middle and leg stump that is a lot quicker. du Plessis hangs back and hurriedly stabs at it. Keeps it out eventually
very full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis digs it out but can't beat the fielder at extra cover
full delivery on off stump. du Plessis gets forward and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Kohli goes back and turns it into the on side for one more run
full toss on off stump. du Plessis drives it towards extra cover and gets across to the other end. Missed out there!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Kohli goes back and punches it towards cover. Both batters hesitate and in the end, du Plessis has to dive to complete the single
length delivery on the pads again. Kohli eases it towards deep square leg for another single
short, wide and punished! Too much width outside off stump and that is easy pickings for Kohli! Throws his hands at it and thrashes it past point for four!
full delivery slanted into leg stump. du Plessis tucks it off his pads past mid wicket for another single
length delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli takes a step down the track and flicks it towards deep square leg for one
length delivery on middle and leg stump that swings into the batter. du Plessis works it into the leg side to get off the mark
length delivery on off stump that shapes away a little. Kohli drops it into the off side and calls his skipper through for the single

that will be that! RCB win by 112 runs! Tossed up on a full length on middle and leg stump, and Asif's eyes light up. He tries to smash it into next week but toe-ends it horribly. The ball goes miles up into the air and when it comes down, Kohli is under it to gobble up the chance! What a performance this has been from RCB; what an abject display this was from RR, though!
full delivery just outside off stump. Asif comes forward and blocks it towards short extra cover

Zampa tries the reverse, and departs! Length delivery on off stump that seems to just grip and spin away a little. Zampa tries the funky reverse sweep and plays all over it as the ball kisses the top of off stump!
full delivery outside off stump. Sandeep pushes it back to the bowler

Hetmyer perishes! Given just a bit of air on a length on middle and off stump. Hetmyer tries to smash it over long on but for a change, mistimes it completely. In fact, it comes off the toe-end of the bat and Bracewell has the simplest of catches at long on!
length delivery at the stumps. Hetmyer lets the ball come to him before offering a dead bat
length delivery fired into leg stump. Hetmyer nurdles it into the leg side and Zampa responds well enough to complete the second
short outside off. Zampa rocks back and cuts it towards deep cover point for a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Zampa pokes it towards mid off
length delivery outside off stump. Zampa hangs back and punches it towards deep point to get off the mark
back of a length delivery on off stump. Zampa defends it towards the bowler
length delivery just outside off stump. Zampa comes half forward and prods it into the off side
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer cuts it towards point, who misfields and ends up conceding a single
length delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer lunges forward and jabs it towards point

shot! Tossed up into the slot outside off stump. Hetmyer plants his front foot and chips it towards long off. Kohli makes a valiant effort to get to it but ends up grassing the chance. Goes for four too!

short and wide outside off stump. Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it towards deep point. Ashwin wants the second but is sent back. He stretches out to regain his ground but Rawat has done well to flick the throw back onto the stumps. Has he done well enough, though? Looks like he has! Ashwin is just inches short of his ground when the bails come off, and RR, to add to their woes, now have a run out as well!
three sixes in the over! Full and outside off stump. Hetmyer gets down on one knee, fetches it and pummels it flat over long on
six more! Full and angled into the stumps. Hetmyer comes out of his bunker again and smacks it over wide long on!
Hetmyer is not going to die wondering! In the slot at the stumps. Hetmyer dances down the track in a flash and mousses it over wide long on!
length outside off stump again. Hetmyer goes for the cut but is beaten for pace for the second successive delivery
back of a length delivery outside off stump that skids through. Hetmyer has a swish at it and misses

holes out to deep mid wicket! This is a procession! Dragged down on off stump and that ought to have travelled the distance. Such is RR's plight, though, that Jurel, despite picking the length early, hits this long-hop straight down Lomror throat at deep mid wicket!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer scuffs it towards deep cover point for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jurel goes back and cuts it towards deep point to get off the mark
length delivery outside off stump. Jurel lunges forward and prods it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jurel waits in his crease and defends into the on side
back of a length delivery on off stump. Hetmyer rocks onto the back foot and knocks it down the ground for a single
length delivery outside off stump. Jurel presses forward and pats it into the off side
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jurel gets up on his toes and dabs it down to short third man
full delivery outside off stump. Jurel comes forward and pushes it down the ground towards mid off

huge appeal, and given! Slower yorker on middle and leg stump that seems to dip very late. Root does not seem to pick it and plays all over it as the ball goes past the bat and thuds into the pads. Root has taken this upstairs but it might be more in hope than expectation. Nothing on UltraEdge and three reds on Ball Tracking. Root's debut IPL innings comes to an end and RR slip deeper into trouble!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Hetmyer tucks it off his hips past mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Root hangs back and works it towards deep mid wicket for one
full delivery just outside off stump. Hetmyer comes onto the front foot and stabs it back to the bowler
tossed up a little on a length on off stump. Hetmyer lunges forward and defends into the on side
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Hetmyer goes back and jabs it into the off side
and he starts off with six, wow! In the arc, and out of the park! Hetmyer plants his front foot, gets his hands through the ball and sends it soaring over long on!

Padikkal bites the dust too! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Padikkal flicks it powerfully but the only problem is that he hits it too close to Siraj at mid wicket. Siraj swoops down low and seems to complete a smart catch. The umpires, though, have referred it upstairs. The ball seems to go into his hands on the full but then seems to be very close to the ground. The question is whether he has his fingers underneath it at all times. The third umpire, after a few looks, decides that Siraj's fingers are underneath the ball and Padikkal has to walk back!
back of a length delivery on the pads. Root hangs back and tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
short delivery on off stump. Root gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Root advances and swishes at it. Misses it completely and the umpire does not call it a wide either
length delivery just outside off stump. Root goes back and defends into the off side
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Padikkal is a little late on the stroke as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side for a leg bye
slower bumper outside off stump. Root hops up onto his toes and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket for one
full delivery angled into the stumps. Root comes forward and flicks it towards mid wicket
full toss outside off stump. Root turns it into the leg side and sets off for the single. Might have been struggling had Maxwell gathered the ball cleanly
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Root takes a step down the track and stabs it into the on side
banged into the track outside off stump. Root gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards square leg
oh, hello! Full delivery outside off stump and Root has had enough of pushing and prodding! Shuffles across his stumps and laps it over short fine leg for four!

huge appeal, and given! Length delivery on off stump that nips back sharply. Root falls over a touch and then plays all around it as the ball pings into the pads. Siraj goes up and so does the umpire's finger. Was that not a little high? Root has reviewed this! No bat involved and Ball Tracking, as expected, shows that the ball would have sailed over the stumps! In fact, it was missing the stumps quite comfortably!
length delivery angled into off stump. Root gets behind the line of the ball and plays it with a straight bat
gets off the mark! Full delivery just outside off stump. Padikkal gets onto the front foot and drives it neatly past mid on for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Padikkal gets up on his toes and defends it towards backward point

RR are three down, oh my word! Back of a length delivery on off stump that holds in the surface again. Samson tries to swipe it away but is way too early into the stroke. The ball skews up and goes miles up into the air. Rawat calls early and does the job!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Root turns it into the leg side and hares across to the other end

Buttler departs for a duck too, would you believe it?! Short, wide and on most days, Buttler would have thrashed it past point. Today, though, the ball just sticks in the surface enough to make Buttler lose control of the stroke. Chips it towards cover point, where Siraj does the rest!
banged into the track down the leg side. Buttler advances and has a swing at it but misses. Called a wide by the umpire, and rightly so!
back of a length delivery angled across outside off first up. Buttler has a fish at it and sees the ball sneak past the flailing blade
shot! Full delivery outside off stump and the extra width allows Samson to throw his hands at it and carve it over extra cover for four!
length delivery outside off stump. Samson has a loose waft at it without any foot movement and is comprehensively beaten
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Samson gets up on his toes and taps it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Samson comes half forward and plonks it back to the bowler

straight to mid off! Siraj breaks the game open! Full and just outside off stump. Jaiswal plants his front foot and tries to go over mid off. Does not quite get under it, though, and ends up drilling it straight to Kohli at mid off! Just the start RCB were after; just what RR did not need!
full delivery fired down the leg side. Jaiswal does not get bat on it as the keeper dives to his right and gathers. Called a wide, though
full delivery on leg stump that shapes in late. Jaiswal gets his bat down in time and pokes it into the on side
